 Is the crackdown on the misuse of taxpayer dollars important to your vote in the midterms? Vote in the poll above or click here . 
 President Trump and Vice President JD Vance will announce a new $25 million whistleblower incentive program today, offering Americans up to $30,000 for tips leading to fraud convictions or major federal enforcement actions. 
 Trump is also expected to award independent journalist Nick Shirley $10,000 for exposing suspected fraud in Minnesota.
